label: violates
requirement: A guest cancelling before the stated deadline gets the entire amount paid back as money, with no retained fee.
meaning_constraints: Use varied explicit counterexamples: voucher only; retained handling fee; only partial refund; deposit forfeited; non-refundable advance purchase; money never returned even before the cutoff.

clauses.text: Q: What happens if I cancel my booking? A: Cancellation results in a travel voucher only; please note that no cash or card reimbursement is offered under any circumstances.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the voucher-only outcome and the specific negation of cash/card reimbursement.

clauses.text: Dear Valued Client, please be advised that the prepaid rate is non-refundable, even if your cancellation is made early in the booking period.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the non-refundable status and the condition regarding early cancellation.

clauses.text: *On cancellation, the deposit is retained by the property and only the remaining balance is returned to the guest.
clauses.rationale: Kept the retention of the deposit and the specific return of only the balance.

clauses.text: Please note that even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from your total refund amount.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the EUR 30 amount, the administration fee type, and the timing before the deadline.

clauses.text: In the event of cancellation, guests receive a travel voucher only; no cash or card reimbursement is offered by the supplier.
clauses.rationale: Retained the voucher-only policy and the explicit exclusion of cash or card refunds.

clauses.text: Terms: The prepaid rate is non-refundable. This policy applies even if cancellation is early.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the non-refundable nature of the prepaid rate and the early cancellation clause.

clauses.text: I understand your request; however, on cancellation, the deposit is retained and only the balance is returned to your account.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the retention of the deposit and the fact that only the balance is returned.

clauses.text: If you cancel, even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from the refund.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the EUR 30 fee, the administration purpose, and the timing relative to the deadline.

clauses.text: Cancellation Policy: Cancellation gives a travel voucher only; no cash or card reimbursement is offered for this booking.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the voucher-only provision and the negation of cash/card reimbursements.

clauses.text: Notice: The prepaid rate is non-refundable, even if cancellation is early. Please plan your travel accordingly.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the non-refundable status and the specific condition regarding early cancellation.

clauses.text: Our policy states that on cancellation, the deposit is retained and only the balance is returned to the customer.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the retention of the deposit and the return of only the balance.

clauses.text: Refund Policy: Even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from the refund.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the EUR 30 fee, the administration type, and the timing before the deadline.
